steps: List every detector behind a brief 1b verdict and every testnet layer (build_default_registry): file, function, bars, timeframe.
Truncation test at 200 seeded DEV timestamps (full data vs data cut at t) and a poison test (after-t bars set to NaN, then x10): signals at or before t must not change.
Static sweep: resample labels, center=True, shift(-, iloc[i+1], peaks, merge_asof, higher-TF joins; each hit safe/unsafe with file:line.
Clock conventions (lead L6): bar stamp (open/close) and session definition per study; DEV events that change label under the other convention.
Entry timing: entry index vs signal-bar close in every study, 10 events per study checked by hand.
